jobs.title: Art Director 100% (f/m/d) - Zurich
jobs.description:
At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

The Art Director is responsible for shaping and elevating the visual expression of the brand across advertising campaigns, marketing initiatives, and key brand touchpoints. The role develops compelling creative concepts and visual narratives that bring the brand strategy to life and create distinctive, memorable, and effective communications.

Working closely with the campaign manager, the branding team, and agencies, the Art Director ensures that all creative output meets the highest standards of design excellence, supports business objectives, and strengthens long-term brand equity.

YOUR CHALLENGE
Creative Concept Development:

• Develop creative concepts and visual territories for integrated advertising campaigns

• Translate strategic briefs and business objectives into compelling visual ideas

• Collaborate with copywriters, creative teams, and agencies to create engaging storytelling and campaign platforms

• Develop and evolve distinctive brand assets, recurring visual devices, and creative mechanics that increase recognisability, memorability, and differentiation across all campaigns

Brand Stewardship:

• Act as a guardian of the brand’s visual identity, ensuring consistency across all communications and touchpoints

• Drive the development and application of brand assets, design systems, and creative guidelines

• Help evolve the visual expression of the brand while maintaining consistency and recognisability

Campaign and Marketing Collaboration:

• Manage creative development from concept through final delivery

• Provide clear creative direction to agencies, photographers, designers, and production partners

• Ensure quality control across all produced assets and campaign materials

YOUR PROFILE
Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in: Graphic Design, Visual Communication, Art Direction or a related discipline

• Fluent in English, German is a plus

Experience:

• 3-5 years of experience in art direction, advertising, visual design, or brand communications

• Strong portfolio demonstrating excellence in campaign and brand development

• Experience collaborating with agencies, creative teams, and production partners

• Experience across digital and print channels

• Experience in financial services, luxury, premium, or professional services brands is a plus

Technical Skills:

• Art direction and creative concept development

• Visual storytelling and advertising design

• Brand identity and design systems

• Creative asset production across digital and print media

Personal Skills:

• Strong creative and conceptual thinking

• Excellent visual judgement and attention to detail

• Strong communication and presentation skills

• Collaborative approach and ability to build relationships across teams

• Ability to manage multiple projects in a dynamic environment

• Esperienza di collaborazione con agenzie, team creativi e partner di produzione

• Collaborer avec des rédacteurs, des équipes de création et des agences pour créer des plateformes de narration et de campagne intéressantes

• Développer et développer des actifs distinctifs de marque, des dispositifs visuels récurrents et des mécanismes créatifs qui accroissent la reconnaissance, la mémorabilité et la différenciation dans toutes les campagnes

• Agir en tant que gardien de l'identité visuelle de la marque, en assurant la cohérence de toutes les communications et points de contact

• Favoriser le développement et l'application des actifs de marque, des systèmes de conception et des lignes directrices créatives

• Aider à développer l'expression visuelle de la marque tout en maintenant la cohérence et la reconnaissance

• Gérer le développement créatif du concept à la prestation finale

• Fournir une orientation créative claire aux agences, aux photographes, aux concepteurs et aux partenaires de production

• Assurer le contrôle de la qualité de tous les biens produits et du matériel de campagne

• Baccalauréat en : Graphisme, communication visuelle, direction artistique ou discipline connexe

• Fluent en anglais, allemand est un plus

• 3-5 ans d'expérience dans la direction artistique, la publicité, le design visuel ou la communication de marque

• Portefeuille solide démontrant l'excellence dans le développement de la campagne et de la marque

• Expérience en collaboration avec des agences, des équipes créatives et des partenaires de production

• Expérience sur les canaux numériques et imprimés

• L'expérience des marques de services financiers, de luxe, de prime ou de services professionnels est un plus

• Direction artistique et développement de concepts créatifs

• Scénario visuel et design publicitaire

• Identification de la marque et systèmes de conception

• Production d'actifs créatifs dans les médias numériques et imprimés

Compétences personnelles :

• Une pensée créative et conceptuelle forte

• Excellent jugement visuel et attention au détail

• Fortes compétences en communication et en présentation

• Approche concertée et capacité d'établir des relations entre les équipes

• Capacité de gérer plusieurs projets dans un environnement dynamique

The Investment Risk & Portfolio Engineering team is part of the CIO Office which is responsible for managing all discretionary mandates of Julius Baer.

We are responsible for maintaining the asset allocations for all multi asset class mandates. We design and update the strategic and tactical asset allocations for these mandates, provide quantitative analysis to the Investment Committee and run ex-ante risk and liquidity reports.

We also manage the market and liquidity risk of our discretionary mandates and all our funds, equity, fixed income and multi-asset. Support of portfolio managers for portfolio construction and relationship managers with optimizations and analysis for bespoke mandates for ultra-high-net-worth (UHNW) clients is also part of our role. We build, maintain and improve our proprietary tools deployed for our daily job.

We are looking for a motivated new colleague to expand our team and help us with our growing responsibilities.

YOUR CHALLENGE

• Deliver strategic asset allocation optimizations and quantitative analysis for large bespoke mandates to relationship managers for UHNW portfolios and participate in client meetings upon request

• Maintain, further automate and constantly improve our proprietary financial data series database as well as related tools and processes

• Provide high-quality and timely quantitative support for our Investment Committee

YOUR PROFILE

• A Master’s degree or PhD in a quantitative subject (e.g. math, engineering, finance)

• At least 2 years of relevant work experience

• Hands-on experience of portfolio optimization is a plus

• Strong IT skills, including programming and data analysis experience. Working knowledge of MATLAB (or similar programming language) and databases, such as MS ACCESS is required

• Proficiency in English, as well as German or French (both spoken and written)

• Comfortable presenting results to groups of portfolio managers and senior management

• Highly motivated, reliable and well-organized team player

• Fornire un sostegno quantitativo di alta qualità e tempestivo per il nostro Comitato per gli investimenti

• Almeno 2 anni di esperienza lavorativa rilevante

• Esperienza pratica di ottimizzazione del portafoglio è un plus

• Forte competenze IT, compresa la programmazione e l'esperienza di analisi dei dati. Conoscenza di lavoro di MATLAB (o linguaggio di programmazione simile) e database, come MS ACCESS è richiesto

• Competenza in inglese, tedesco o francese (sia parlato che scritto)

• Confortevole presentare i risultati a gruppi di manager di portafoglio e senior management

• Giocatore di squadra altamente motivato, affidabile e ben organizzato

Kick-start your career with Julius Baer’s Graduate Programme – April 2027

Are you about to complete your master’s degree or recently graduated and ready to turn ambition into impact? At Julius Baer, we empower graduates to shape the future of wealth management.

• Impactful work: Contribute to projects that make a real difference from day one

• Analyse end-to-end client and business processes to identify opportunities for AI-driven re-design and enhanced efficiency

• Partner with stakeholders to re-imagine end to end journeys, challenge assumptions, build compelling value hypotheses, and ensure readiness for implementation

• Support the successful implementation of prioritised AI use cases, ensuring business outcomes are delivered

• Sviluppare una comprensione del processo di traduzione FX (traduzioni OCI) e l'impatto delle siepi di investimento nette sul mix FX di capitale

• Collaborare con il Gruppo Contabilità responsabile per la divulgazione di FX, IRR e hedge accounting nel bilancio annuale

At Julius Baer, we celebrate and value the individual qualities you bring, enabling you to be impactful, to be entrepreneurial, to be empowered, and to create value beyond wealth. Let’s shape the future of wealth management together.

Are you passionate about creating value through technology and driving meaningful change at a global financial institution? Join our AI Office and play a key role in accelerating the bank’s AI transformation.

Working closely with stakeholders across functions, geographies, and business lines, you will help identify high-impact AI journeys & opportunities and drive their successful implementation and value realisation. From shaping strategic priorities and influencing the AI roadmap to ensuring adoption and measurable business outcomes, you will operate at the intersection of innovation, business, and change.

YOUR CHALLENGE
AI Opportunity Funnel

• Systematically collect and evaluate AI ideas originating across the bank, conducting initial assessments and providing recommendations

• Analyse end-to-end client and business processes to identify opportunities for AI- driven re-design and enhanced efficiency

• Partner with stakeholders to re-imagine end to end journeys, challenge assumptions, build compelling value hypotheses, and ensure readiness for implementation

• Develop and apply a consistent framework to evaluate and prioritise AI opprtunities, aligned with strategic objectives and stakeholder expectations

• Translate prioritised AI opportunities into delivery-ready initiatives, working closely with the AI ART and other units within the bank to successfully deliver prioritised use cases

AI Value Realisation

• Support the successful implementation of prioritised AI use cases, ensuring business outcomes are delivered

• Lead and present strategic AI initiatives to relevant stakeholders, adapting messages to different audiences and ensuring clear, compelling communication

• Define, monitor and report on agreed KPIs, ensuring transparency on progress, adoption and value delivered

AI Governance & Strategy

• Contribute to the development and execution of the bank's AI strategy, ensuring alignment with business objectives

• Support the preparation of materials and decision-making for the AI Steering Committee and other senior governance bodies overseeing the bank's AI journey

• Partner with senior management and stakeholders to continuously enhance the bank's AI governance framework

• Collaborate closely with the Responsible AI Committee, Model Risk Management and other risk functions

YOUR PROFILE

• Bachelor’s degree in Business, Economics, Technology, Data Science, or another relevant field

• 5+ years of professional experience in financial services, wealth management, private banking, consulting, or another highly regulated environment is preferred

• Digital Enablement: Familiarity with AI technology, process re-engineering, workflow automation and analytics tools. Understanding and enhancing banking tools and business architecture

• Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build trust, influence across levels, and navigate complex matrix organisations

• Excellent communication and storytelling skills, with the ability to translate complex transformation topics into clear, engaging, and actionable messages

• Strong analytical mindset, with experience using feedback, adoption metrics, or readiness assessments to inform change activities and measure impact

• Structured, proactive, and delivery-oriented working style, with the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced transformation environment
